What if everyone on Earth got a million dollars?
Eight billion people. One million dollars each.
In hundred-dollar bills? Eighty million tons.
Day one: you quit your job. Party!
No farmers. No truckers. No bakers.
But the shops have the same stuff as before.
Just way more money chasing it.
A single burger could cost thousands of dollars.
Zimbabwe once printed a hundred trillion dollar note!
So... what would you buy on day one?
